_meta.description: Default MTProto (Telegram tgnet) byte-pattern database for friTap
_meta.notes: Per-protocol pattern file (library -> os -> arch -> function -> [patterns]), loaded and merged alongside default_patterns.json. See default_patterns.json for the TLS database.

categories.getAuthKey: Datacenter::getAuthKey — transport auth-key extraction (dumps auth_key_id, auth_key, dc_id, perm/temp) for the MTProto keylog hook
categories.decryptInbound: post-AES-IGE-decrypt inbound plaintext buffer site (live plaintext mode; future)
categories.encryptOutbound: pre-AES-IGE-encrypt outbound plaintext buffer site (live plaintext mode; future)

_docs.notes: Patterns are Frida space-separated hex, '??' wildcards allowed, and must not begin/end with '??'. Contributed per library per OS per arch per function.
